text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [App Fusion] [Globemon] & [Charismon]: Cost 0 (If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.)

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Blocker＞ ＜Link +1＞ (Add 1 to this Digimon's maximum links.) [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] You may link 1 Digimon card with the [Appmon] trait from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards to 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost. [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your Digimon get linked, by unsuspending this Digimon, trash your opponent's top security card.
